narr: A small but nearly stationary cluster of thunderstorms occurred ahead of a cold front extending from Lake Michigan down across central Missouri. Flash flooding occurred under this stationary cluster of storms.
ev: There were numerous reports of street flooding in Marion. Significant street flooding occurred across the city of Johnston City, where over four inches of rain fell from midnight to late morning. Poor Farm Road was washed out north of Johnston City, leaving a trench large enough to swallow a car. On the north side of Marion, fire and rescue crews assisted residents of a flooded trailer park. The park was entirely flooded, and some residents were advised to remain indoors. Main Street on the east side of the Marion square was nearly impassable. A Marion day care center was evacuated due to flooding. Several inches of water were in the classrooms and hallway. A Cocorahs observer at Marion measured 5.63 inches in a 48-hour period.
